name: Four-level Volume-Loading Pipeline with Min-Max Trimming
aliases: Texture Mapping Hardware Volume Rendering with Preprocessing
definition: A volume rendering method for large data using 3D texture mapping hardware that uses a four-level pipeline (Disk -> Volume Buffer -> Texture Buffer -> Texture Cache) to skip empty voxels by classifying and trimming volume blocks based on min-max arrays before loading them into texture memory.
summary: This method accelerates volume rendering by preprocessing data to exclude empty voxels using min-max trimming, reducing data transfer and saving 40 to 60 percent of rendering time.
